faqs.question: Who do you sponsor?
faqs.answer: We currently sponsor 35 children, aged 7 to 17, from vulnerable communities across Kenya.

faqs.question: What does sponsorship cover?
faqs.answer: School fees and ongoing mentorship. Our team regularly visits the children's schools and meets them during school holidays to track their progress, encourage them, and walk alongside their families.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to sponsor a child?
faqs.answer: [CONFIRM: cost per term / year, and whether to show it]

faqs.question: How do I start sponsoring a child?
faqs.answer: Send us a sponsorship enquiry. A member of our team will get in touch with you personally to talk it through.

faqs.question: Where do you work?
faqs.answer: Our football tournaments and clinics are held across Nairobi, Western Kenya and the Coast.
